叶寒冷然拒绝了剑斗罗的收徒邀请。

不是什么人都能成为他的师傅。

想要成为他的师傅，就需要得到他的认可。

若是没有点真本事，拜师就是在浪费他的时间。

“好小子，你够狂啊。”

“你可知道世上有多少人想要拜我为师吗？”

剑斗罗有点生气了。

本来他是没有收徒念头的，还是看在宁风致的面子上才答应的。

只因他收徒也是有条件了，如果不是剑道天才，他宁愿不收徒。

谁能想到，叶寒还不同意了，这让他的脸面往哪儿搁？

“剑前辈，晚辈并没有恶意。”

“你是封号斗罗，想拜你为师的人不计其数。”

“但拜师一事重大，我有自己的要求。”

“只有对方符合我的条件，我才会拜师。”

“否则，没有人能够强迫我。”

叶寒微微抱拳，向剑斗罗做出解释。

“呵呵，有点意思，你小子的性格倒是挺符合老夫的胃口。”

“其实，老夫也没想过收徒。”

“同样的，想要成为我的徒弟，也需要满足我的要求。”

“风致，并不是我不给你面子，而是人家不领情。”

剑斗罗对叶寒表示理解。

从本质上来看，拜师和收徒差不多是一个意思。

叶寒跟他一样，都在追求极致。

“哎，罢了，还是看缘分吧。”

宁风致叹了声气，便不在插手两人拜师和收徒的事情。

“叶寒，你出手吧，让我看看你的能耐。”

“我倒是很好奇，你到底有什么底气，敢自己挑选师傅。”

剑斗罗见宁风致放弃了，示意他可以动手了。

“剑前辈，有劳了。”

叶寒向他微微抱拳施礼，唤出武魂嗜血魔剑。

当他那两枚紫色魂环悬浮而落时，在场所有人都看呆了。

尤其是史莱克学院等人。

在叶寒入学的时候，他的魂环配置还是一黄一紫。

这才过去几天，叶寒的魂环配置直接变成两个千年魂环了。

“老赵，我没看错吧。”

“你不是说这小子的魂环配置是一黄一紫吗？”

“咋变成两个千年魂环了。”

弗兰德揉了揉双眼，发现两枚紫色魂环还是没有任何变化。

他掐了掐大腿，感受到传来的刺痛感，让他不得不相信眼前的事实。

“院长，我也不知道啊。”

“他入学时，魂环配置的确是一黄一紫啊。”

“不信，你问问大家。”

赵无极反复闭眼验证，这才相信眼前的现实。

宁风致和剑斗罗闻言，双眼瞪得老大，难以置信地望着已经做好准备的叶寒。

几天时间便将一黄一紫的魂环配置变成两枚千年魂环。

就算是变魔术，也没有这么快吧。

“叶寒大哥，你的魂环怎么变了。”

“我记得你的第一枚魂环就是一只五百年左右的疾风狼啊。”

Ye Hanran abruptly rejected Sword Douluo's invitation to become a disciple.

Not just anyone can be his master.

If you want to become his master, you need to get his approval.

If he doesn't have some real ability, becoming a disciple is a waste of his time.

"Good boy, you are so crazy."

"Do you know how many people in the world want to worship me as their teacher?"

Sword Douluo was a little angry.

Originally, he had no intention of accepting a disciple, but he agreed because of Ning Fengzhi's face.

Just because he has conditions to accept a disciple, if he is not a swordsman genius, he would rather not accept a disciple.

Who would have thought that Ye Han still agreed, where would this put his face?

"Senior Jian, this junior has no ill intentions."

"You are a titled Douluo, and there are countless people who want to become your disciple."

"But becoming a disciple is a very important matter, and I have my own requirements."

"I will become a disciple only if the other party meets my conditions."

"Otherwise, no one can force me."

Ye Han cupped his fists slightly and explained to Sword Douluo.

"Haha, that's interesting. Your personality is quite to my liking."

"Actually, I never thought about taking on a disciple."

"Similarly, if you want to be my disciple, you also need to meet my requirements."

"Fengzhi, it's not that I don't give you face, it's that people don't appreciate it."

Sword Douluo expressed his understanding to Ye Han.

In essence, apprenticeship and apprenticeship mean almost the same thing.

Ye Han, like him, is pursuing perfection.

"Hey, that's all, it depends on fate."

Ning Fengzhi sighed and stopped interfering in the two's apprenticeship and apprenticeship.

"Ye Han, take action and let me see what you are capable of."

"I'm curious, what confidence do you have to choose your own master?"

Seeing that Ning Fengzhi had given up, Sword Douluo signaled that he could take action.

"Senior Jian, you're done."

Ye Han slightly cupped his fists and saluted him, summoning the Wuhun Bloodthirsty Demonic Sword.

When his two purple soul rings floated down, everyone present was stunned.

Especially Shrek Academy and others.

When Ye Han entered school, his soul ring configuration was still one yellow and one purple.

Only a few days have passed, and Ye Han's soul ring configuration has directly changed to two thousand-year soul rings.

"Old Zhao, am I right?"

"Didn't you say that this kid's soul ring configuration is one yellow and one purple?"

"Why did they become two thousand-year soul rings?"

Flanders rubbed his eyes and found that there was still no change in the two purple soul rings.

He pinched his thigh and felt the tingling sensation, which forced him to believe the facts before him.

"Dean, I don't know either."

"When he entered school, his soul ring configuration was indeed one yellow and one purple."

"If you don't believe it, ask everyone."

Zhao Wuji closed his eyes repeatedly to verify, and then he believed the reality in front of him.

When Ning Fengzhi and Sword Douluo heard this, their eyes widened and they looked at the prepared Ye Han in disbelief.

In a few days, the configuration of one yellow and one purple soul ring was transformed into two thousand-year soul rings.

Even if it's magic, it's not that fast.

"Brother Ye Han, why has your soul ring changed?"

"I remember that your first spirit ring was a five-hundred-year-old wind wolf."
